description: Remove a file from a wiki page, by its 'filename' as listed by get_wiki_page. Identify the page by 'pageId', or by 'spaceKey' + 'title'. References to it in the page body are left alone — they simply stop resolving, so tidy the body too if it named the file. Requires permission to edit the page.

filename.description: File name to remove, as listed by get_wiki_page.

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.

name: delete_wiki_attachment
